fact: Caboverde24, citing Cabo Verde Telecom, reports that three international submarine cable systems, WACS, EllaLink and SHARE, currently reach Praia, with direct routes to Lisbon, West Africa and Fortaleza (Brazil); all at Praia, so not independent.
ECOWAS says the six countries of the Amilcar Cabral project currently have only one landing station.
CVTelecom's outgoing CEO told Expresso das Ilhas that Cabo Verde has three international submarine cables landed, including WACS and EllaLink.
